role_boundary: Controls represent publication-time citation opportunity, exposure, team scale, or measurement opportunity. They are auxiliary prediction features and must never be interpreted as paper-innovation indicators.
inclusion_rule: A control is admitted only when citation-determinant or bibliographic-network literature supports its nuisance/opportunity role, it is known no later than publication, it is locally reproducible, and its missingness is preserved for fold-local imputation.
exclusion_rule: Exclude current journal impact factors, post-publication open-access changes, future citations, post-publication author prestige, and any quality or retrieval flag used as a substantive predictor.

BORNMANN_DANIEL2008.citation: Bornmann L, Daniel H-D (2008). What do citation counts measure? A review of studies on citing behavior. Journal of Documentation 64:45-80.
BORNMANN_DANIEL2008.role: Citation counts are multidimensional influence signals and require careful opportunity controls.

TAHAMTAN2016.citation: Tahamtan I, Safipour Afshar A, Ahamdzadeh K (2016). Factors affecting number of citations: a comprehensive review of the literature. Scientometrics 107:1195-1225.
TAHAMTAN2016.role: Review evidence for field, age, title, reference-list, journal, collaboration, country, institution, author-count and productivity covariates.

TAHAMTAN_BORNMANN2020.citation: Tahamtan I, Bornmann L (2019). What do citation counts measure? An updated review of studies on citations in scientific documents published between 2006 and 2018. Scientometrics 121:1635-1684.
TAHAMTAN_BORNMANN2020.role: Updated citation-determinant evidence and interpretation limits.

WANG2015.citation: Wang J, Thijs B, Glanzel W (2015). Interdisciplinarity and Impact: Distinct Effects of Variety, Balance, and Disparity. PLOS ONE 10:e0127298.
WANG2015.role: Paper-level use of journal, author, country and reference-count controls alongside diversity indicators.

BISCARO2014.citation: Biscaro C, Giupponi C (2014). Co-Authorship and Bibliographic Coupling Network Effects on Citations. PLOS ONE 9:e99502.
BISCARO2014.role: Bibliographic-coupling position as a publication-time citation-opportunity predictor.

GUAN2017.citation: Guan J, Yan Y, Zhang JJ (2017). The impact of collaboration and knowledge networks on citations. Journal of Informetrics 11:407-422.
GUAN2017.role: Collaboration and knowledge-network position as citation predictors.

publication_year.meaning: Controls exposure era and secular changes in citation practices.
publication_year.missing_rule: Missing year excludes the paper before modeling.

domain12.meaning: Controls broad field differences in citation and diffusion opportunity.
domain12.missing_rule: Out-of-scope or missing domain is not silently reassigned.

openalex_primary_subfield.meaning: Controls finer field heterogeneity remaining inside domain12.
openalex_primary_subfield.maximum_information_time: frozen snapshot metadata for the publication record
openalex_primary_subfield.missing_rule: Missing label becomes an explicit training-fold unknown category.

venue_family.meaning: Controls venue-format and exposure differences without using a current prestige score.
venue_family.missing_rule: Missing venue becomes an explicit training-fold unknown category.

log_reference_count.formula: ln(1 + number of distinct declared references)
log_reference_count.meaning: Controls citation opportunity and the mechanical number of possible reference combinations.
log_reference_count.missing_rule: Unretrieved lists are missing; a verified empty list is zero.

reference_age_median.meaning: Controls the central recency of the cited knowledge base.
reference_age_median.missing_rule: No dated prior reference is null.

reference_age_iqr.meaning: Controls dispersion in the ages of cited knowledge.
reference_age_iqr.missing_rule: Insufficient dated prior references are null.

title_word_count.formula: count of regex word tokens in the frozen title
title_word_count.meaning: Controls a documented article-presentation correlate of citations.
title_word_count.missing_rule: Empty or unavailable title is null.

log_author_count.meaning: Controls team scale and associated visibility/collaboration opportunity.
log_author_count.missing_rule: Missing frozen OpenAlex authorship metadata is null.

log_institution_count.missing_rule: Missing frozen OpenAlex affiliation metadata is null.

log_country_count.meaning: Controls international collaboration and geographic exposure.
log_country_count.missing_rule: Missing frozen OpenAlex country metadata is null.

log_team_prior_nature_output_max.formula: ln(1 + maximum strictly-prior Nature-cohort paper count across focal authors)
log_team_prior_nature_output_max.meaning: Strong sensitivity control for prior team productivity; it is not all-OpenAlex career output.
log_team_prior_nature_output_max.missing_rule: No locally matched author IDs is null.

log_prior_reference_popularity_median.formula: median over focal references of ln(1 + strictly-prior Nature citation count)
log_prior_reference_popularity_median.meaning: Controls prior popularity of the knowledge base selected by the paper.
log_prior_reference_popularity_median.missing_rule: No valid prior references is null.

bc_degree_per_reference_t0.formula: number of strictly-prior papers sharing at least one reference with focal / max(1, valid_reference_count)
bc_degree_per_reference_t0.missing_rule: Unavailable prior coupling view is null; a verified isolate is zero.

bc_shared_reference_strength_t0.formula: sum over strictly-prior neighbor papers of references shared with the focal paper
bc_shared_reference_strength_t0.meaning: Controls the strength of pre-existing bibliographic similarity.
bc_shared_reference_strength_t0.missing_rule: Unavailable prior coupling view is null; verified no overlap is zero.

bc_component_share_t0.formula: size of focal augmented coupling component / number of eligible strictly-prior papers
bc_component_share_t0.meaning: Controls breadth of the pre-existing connected opportunity neighborhood.
bc_component_share_t0.missing_rule: Unavailable prior coupling view is null.
